Class CacheStrategy

java.lang.Object
NetStrategies.CacheStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCheck
Direct Known Subclasses:
FIFOCache, LFUCache, LIFOCache, LRUCache, MRUCache, PLRUCache, RandomCache, TTLCache
public abstract class CacheStrategy extends Object implements AutoCheck
Base class of the cache eviction strategies of the JSIM engine: it decides which cached item is removed when the cache is full.
